purpose: Pruebas de diseño para asegurar que la materialización procedural respeta las tres funciones canónicas de Villa.

expected: exactly one V1 coastal civil shipyard profile exists when the canonical three Villas are materialized
exactly one V2 forest logistics profile exists
exactly one V3 agropastoral commercial profile exists
profile identity does not reroll

cases.setup: materialize all three Villas in the same world state
expected: V1 resident population is greater than V2 and V3 resident populations
large civil shipbuilding present
royal warship construction absent
royal warship construction remains assigned to Treskal

cases.setup: generate V1 administration and economic assets
expected: major civil shipyards remain House Valrik property
minor House administration does not automatically imply shipyard ownership
civil urban core lies outside dense Black Forest interior
timber extraction routes connect to forest installations
timber reception sorting storage and dispatch are prominent
specialized woodworking identity does not replace Treskal
large furniture craftsmanship prestige is not transferred automatically
daily market exists
market activity intensity may vary by day and season
regional storage and livestock handling are present

cases.setup: generate V3 visual and economic output
expected: Villa is important within Valrik
Villa is not represented as Norgard primary granary
Arleon scale and identity are not copied

cases.setup: market day, ship arrival or large convoy
expected: transient population may increase visible activity
resident census remains unchanged unless world state records actual settlement
minor House administers locally
superior authority remains House Valrik and Crown
serious crimes are referred to Treskal
death penalty is not imposed autonomously by minor House

cases.setup: assign or change visible Villa name while preserving stable instance ID
expected: profile unchanged
population unchanged
services unchanged
layout unchanged
engine may expand existing capacity instead of forcing a new building when coherent
walls are absent unless separately justified by canon, history or strategic need
